top_signals.title: Lockheed’s New PAC-3 Edge interceptor aims for agility
top_signals.summary: The defense giant unveiled the PAC-3 Edge this Friday and debuted it at the Association of the U.S. Army’s annual meeting on Monday.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
